Exclusive Perks

Everything you receive as a host

We don't just give you a title - we provide you with an entire business-in-a-box loaded with resources, high-level support, and unparalleled exposure.

Free Access to All Events

Attend every Titans event across all UK locations at zero cost. Network, learn, and grow - without paying a penny.

What We Ask

What we do for you.

Hosting is a commitment to excellence. Here's what it takes to run a Titans chapter.

📋
01

Organise Monthly Events

Plan and run one property networking event per month in your designated location. We provide the playbook - you bring the energy.

🏘️
02

Build Your Local Community

Grow a thriving community of property professionals in your area. Cultivate relationships and facilitate meaningful introductions.

⭐
03

Maintain Brand Standards

Deliver the Titans experience at every event - premium venues, quality speakers, structured networking, and hot buffet dining.

📣
04

Promote & Market

Drive attendance through social media, WhatsApp, and local outreach. We supply content templates and marketing playbooks.

📊
05

Report & Collaborate

Share monthly performance updates, attend strategy meetings, and collaborate with the wider host network.

Full Support

We set you up for success

Running an event can be daunting. That's why we provide end-to-end support so you can focus on what matters - building your community.

🎯

Event Playbook

Step-by-step guide covering venue selection, speaker booking, pricing strategy, and day-of-event logistics.

🎨

Brand & Marketing Kit

Professional graphics, social media templates, email sequences, and promotional materials - all ready to deploy.

💻

Tech & Ticketing

We set up your event pages, ticketing system, and CRM tools so you can focus on building relationships.

🧑‍🏫

Speaker Network

Access our curated list of expert speakers and panel guests who can add immense value to your attendees.

📞

On-Call Support

Direct line to the Titans team for any questions, challenges, or last-minute needs - you're never alone.

📈

Growth Coaching

Regular one-on-one sessions to review your chapter's performance, set goals, and unlock your next level.

Your Journey

Growth opportunities that compound

Hosting isn't just about running events - it's a launchpad for your personal brand, network, and property career.

Phase 1

Launch & Establish

Months 1–3
  • Host your first 3 events
  • Build core local network
  • Master the Titans playbook
Phase 2

Grow & Scale

Months 4–8
  • Reach 80+ consistent attendees
  • Develop speaker relationships
  • Build your personal brand
Phase 3

Lead & Expand

Months 9+
  • Explore multi-location expansion
  • Mentor new hosts
  • Unlock revenue opportunities
